$description: Load-bearing rules for anyone GENERATING CODE from this design-repo: the clone is Tailwind v3 reproducing a Tailwind v4 original. These govern the implementation layer; PageSpecs carry no class strings (see tokens/llm/token-policy.json `overrides`).

evidence.quote: The original is Nuxt 3 (Vue) with Tailwind **v4**. The clone uses Tailwind **v3**.

rules.v4: divide-x / divide-y put the rule on every child but the LAST (border-inline-end / border-bottom).
rules.v3: divide-x / divide-y put border-left / border-top on every child but the FIRST, shifting columns 2..n by 1px.
rules.rule: Never use v3 divide-* for a v4 divide; use the explicit scoped classes (border-right on :not(:last-child)).

evidence.quote: /* v4 `sm:divide-x sm:divide-ink-950/10`: v4 draws the rule as border-inline-end on every child but the

rules.v4: text-2xl carries a unitless line-height ratio (2/1.5) that a later md:text-[28px] keeps -> 28px/37.33px.

rules.rule: Homepage hero CTAs are text-[17px] leading-normal at ALL widths (QA correction over CLONE_SPEC's 16px base).

evidence.quote: ai-cta w-full gap-3.5 bg-ink-950 pr-5 pl-6 text-[17px] leading-normal
group w-full gap-2 bg-white/70 px-8 text-[17px] leading-normal

rules.rule: v4 spacing (any N x 0.25rem) is reproduced by generating 0..200 in .5 steps; v4 class names (pt-34, -mt-73, h-12.5) are valid.

evidence.quote: // Tailwind v4 spacing: every N maps to N * 0.25rem

rules.rule: Any integer opacity modifier (bg-ink-950/6) is registered in the v3 config.

evidence.quote: // v4 accepts any integer opacity modifier

rules.rule: Radius scale is the v4 one (sm=4px, DEFAULT=4px, ... 4xl=32px), replacing v3 defaults.

evidence.quote: // CLONE_SPEC 0.3 (v4 radius scale; differs from v3 defaults)

rules.rule: Default border color is currentColor (v4), not v3 gray-200.

evidence.quote: /* v4 default border color is currentColor; v3 uses gray-200. Match v4. */

rules.rule: Buttons get cursor:pointer from the base layer (v4 preflight difference).

evidence.quote: /* v4 preflight: images/svg are block, buttons have no default bg, cursor pointer on buttons */

rules.rule: Focus rings need explicit `outline` in v3: focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-primary-700.
v4 bg-linear-to-b is written bg-gradient-to-b in v3 (pricing wrapper).
No container-query plugin: write plain @container CSS.

evidence.quote: - Container queries: no plugin — write plain `@container` CSS.

rules.rule: Global html.js .hero-line is the HOMEPAGE entrance (.76s, .38s+i*90ms, blur 5px, 14px). Template heroes use scoped classes with .64s / i*70ms / blur 4px / 12px: .tpl-line, .cat-hero .hero-line, .embed-line, .res-hero-line.

evidence.quote: animation: hero-line .76s var(--ease-smooth) calc(.38s + var(--i) * 90ms) both;

rules.rule: Any v4-only syntax copied from saved original markup must be checked against v3 before use.

evidence.quote: - v4-only syntax copied from the saved HTML must be checked against v3.
